title: Revolucion del Empleo Joven
description: Plan de choque contra el desempleo juvenil del 28%. Formacion profesional dual con empresas tecnologicas. Incentivos fiscales para contratar menores de 30 anos con contratos estables.
description_en: Shock plan against 28% youth unemployment. Dual vocational training with tech companies. Tax incentives for hiring under-30s with stable contracts.

title: Vivienda Asequible para Todos
description: Construccion de 500.000 viviendas publicas de alquiler social. Regulacion efectiva de precios en zonas tensionadas. Rehabilitacion energetica de edificios con fondos europeos.
description_en: Construction of 500,000 public social rental housing units. Effective price regulation in stressed areas. Energy rehabilitation of buildings with European funds.

title: Dialogo Federal Constructivo
description: Reforma constitucional para un modelo federal claro y consensuado. Dialogo permanente con Cataluna, Pais Vasco y todas las comunidades. Financiacion autonomica justa y transparente.
description_en: Constitutional reform for a clear and consensual federal model. Permanent dialogue with Catalonia, Basque Country, and all communities. Fair and transparent autonomous financing.

title: Sociedad Longeva Activa
description: Tecnologia al servicio de los mayores con telemedicina y domotica. Reforma de pensiones sostenible con economia plateada. Centros intergeneracionales en cada municipio.
description_en: Technology serving the elderly with telemedicine and home automation. Sustainable pension reform with silver economy. Intergenerational centers in every municipality.

title: Turismo Sostenible de Calidad
description: Transicion del turismo masivo al turismo de alto valor. Limites de capacidad en destinos saturados. Diversificacion economica de zonas dependientes del turismo estacional.
description_en: Transition from mass tourism to high-value tourism. Capacity limits in saturated destinations. Economic diversification of areas dependent on seasonal tourism.

title: Gestion del Agua con IA
description: Plan hidrologico nacional inteligente para combatir la sequia. Desalinizacion con energia solar en la costa mediterranea. Reutilizacion del 100% de aguas residuales urbanas.
description_en: Smart national water plan to combat drought. Solar-powered desalination on the Mediterranean coast. 100% reuse of urban wastewater.

title: Inmigracion Inclusiva
description: Modelo de integracion con formacion lingueistica y profesional desde el primer dia. Reconocimiento agil de titulos extranjeros. Programa de insercion laboral en sectores con deficit de trabajadores.
description_en: Integration model with linguistic and professional training from day one. Agile recognition of foreign degrees. Labor insertion program in sectors with worker shortages.

title: Espana 100% Renovable
description: Objetivo de 100% energia renovable para 2040. Espana como hub europeo de hidrogeno verde. Comunidades energeticas locales y autoconsumo solar en cada hogar.
description_en: 100% renewable energy target by 2040. Spain as European green hydrogen hub. Local energy communities and solar self-consumption in every home.
